title: Eight-sided Great Pyramid and the Templar flag
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Eight-sided Great Pyramid and the Templar flag, about ancient at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

pyramid turned into a 2D shape. So, if
you take the Templar flag and you create
into a threedimensional object, you get

plain: A man named Jay Anderson, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says the flag of the Knights Templar, a medieval order of Christian knights, is really an eight-sided pyramid drawn flat. Take that flag and make it three-dimensional, he says, and you get the Great Pyramid of Giza, which he describes as having eight sides. He credits the idea to other researchers, Dark Journalist and Joseph P. Farrell, and tells it to suggest the Templars were linked to the secrets of ancient Egypt.
